risks.risk: No pathway becomes authorized by March 2027
risks.mitigation: Keep all three paths alive; start Path B formally so authorization does not depend only on external hiring cycles.
risks.trigger: No offer and no approved location change by the Dec 8 benchmark

risks.risk: Role, title or location mismatch on offer
risks.mitigation: Confirm exact title, level, worksite and cadence before acceptance.
risks.trigger: Offer arrives with different terms than discussed

risks.risk: Compensation insufficient for California cost of living
risks.mitigation: Run the recurring monthly delta before acceptance, not after.
risks.trigger: Offer comp below the modeled California recurring requirement

risks.risk: In-office requirement compresses the move timeline
risks.mitigation: Ask for a remote transition period; the timeline engine shows exactly what a short runway breaks.
risks.trigger: Required report date under ~60 days from offer

risks.risk: Hiring process stalls over the holidays
risks.mitigation: Treat Jan-Mar as the practical execution window; do not read December silence as rejection.
risks.trigger: No movement between Dec 15 and Jan 10

risks.risk: Venture X balance persists at 28.49% APR
risks.mitigation: $300 per paycheck baseline, stretch to $400-500 when the cash floor is protected; no new discretionary purchases while revolving.
risks.trigger: Balance not materially reduced by the Nov 15 checkpoint

risks.risk: Move cost exceeds the $10K floor
risks.mitigation: Already true in the model. Use the ladder, not the floor, as the target.
risks.trigger: Already realized

risks.risk: Relocation support is limited or absent
risks.mitigation: Model zero coverage by default; never volunteer to waive support.
risks.trigger: HR states the policy

risks.risk: Deposit and pet fees exceed the model
risks.mitigation: Refresh from live inventory at trigger; keep the contingency intact.
risks.trigger: Live listings quote above $3,200 deposit

risks.risk: The 2027 tax refund does not recur
risks.mitigation: Base case already excludes it.
risks.trigger: Filing season

risks.risk: RSU net is materially lower than the gross estimate
risks.mitigation: Base case excludes it; count only settled net.

risks.risk: Rental income materially below carrying cost
risks.mitigation: Guardrail at $350/month subsidy; the rent branch must clear it to survive.
risks.trigger: PM market-rent opinions below ~$3,249

risks.risk: Landlord reserve ties up too much cash at exactly the wrong moment
risks.mitigation: Count the reserve as required liquidity in the rent branch, and weigh its opportunity cost against the move requirement.
risks.trigger: Rent branch selected while the Launch Fund is short

risks.risk: Replacement inspection reveals meaningful repairs
risks.mitigation: Buy the inspection early (Gate 0) so the finding is cheap news rather than a closing surprise.
risks.trigger: Inspection report

risks.risk: Sale takes longer than expected
risks.mitigation: Model overlap months explicitly; each month is $2,884.54 of exposure.
risks.trigger: No offer by day 21 of listing

risks.risk: Occupied showings create avoidable stress
risks.mitigation: Preferred sequence lists vacant after departure; buying one month of overlap may be worth it.
risks.trigger: Listing while Lane still lives there

risks.risk: Dual housing lasts longer than the modeled one month
risks.mitigation: Model overlap as a variable, not a constant; re-run the budget at 2 and 3 months before committing.
risks.trigger: Month two of overlap

risks.risk: Mover availability or pricing worse than modeled
risks.mitigation: Collect quotes before the trigger; book only after Gate 2.
risks.trigger: Quotes above ~$2,500

risks.risk: Household goods arrive late
risks.mitigation: Plan an air-mattress week; first-week basics budget exists for exactly this.
risks.trigger: Carrier delivery window slips

risks.risk: Storage becomes necessary
risks.mitigation: Timeline engine flags a lease-start-after-pickup gap before it becomes a surprise.
risks.trigger: Lease start later than pickup + transit

risks.risk: Tundra maintenance issue en route
risks.mitigation: Pre-trip service; roadside coverage; buffer day; never push a marginal repair to save half a day.
risks.trigger: Any warning light before or during the trip

risks.risk: Road-trip weather or traffic disruption
risks.mitigation: One buffer day; 6-8 hour driving days leave slack; do not drive tired to make a schedule.
risks.trigger: Forecast on any leg

risks.risk: Pet stress or illness on the road
risks.mitigation: Rehearsal drives, medication trialled in advance, dog stop every ~2 hours, emergency-vet lookup near each overnight stop.
risks.trigger: Any refusal to eat or drink on the road

risks.risk: Dog-friendly yard or patio inventory is limited
risks.mitigation: Widen to Montrose / La Crescenta and ground-floor units; treat secure outdoor space as strongly preferred, not absolute.
risks.trigger: Search returns under ~5 qualifying units

risks.risk: Commute is worse than expected
risks.mitigation: Test the actual commute at the actual office days and times before signing.
risks.trigger: Test drive exceeds 45 minutes

risks.risk: Pressure to sign a lease before employment details are final
risks.mitigation: Gate 3 exists precisely to block this. A lease is the first truly irreversible California commitment.
risks.trigger: Any urge to sign before the worksite and start date are in writing

risks.risk: Trying to recreate every Orlando routine immediately
risks.mitigation: One or two anchors in the first 90 days. Choir first.
risks.trigger: More than two recurring commitments in month one

risks.risk: Interpreting early loneliness as move failure
risks.mitigation: Arrival-grace rules: no verdict in the first 14 days.
risks.trigger: Week one

risks.risk: Nostalgia driving poor house economics
risks.mitigation: Renting must earn the right to beat selling, on written numbers.
risks.trigger: Any argument for renting that does not cite a PM quote

risks.risk: Losing the Gaylord Palms yoga teaching role with nothing equivalent in California
risks.mitigation: Research Southern California resort/hotel yoga instruction as a continuity track, not a side-income optimization.
risks.trigger: Departure date set
